en: Would you please stop that? You're{SAUT}frightening Hikari-san...
They're... not enemies?
Seems as much.
...A cat?
We apologize for startling you two.{SAUT}And, you are...?
My name is Nagi. I am the acting{SAUT}curator of this movie theater.
A curator!? So, this theater isn't really{SAUT}abandoned!
Could it be... that you've all been{SAUT}trapped here as well?
"As well"... Do you mean the same thing{SAUT}has happened to you two?

Yes... It all seems unbelievable, but it{SAUT}happened in the blink of an eye.{PAGE}When I came to, all of the customers{SAUT}had disappeared and the entrance{SAUT}was barred...{PAGE}I quickly began searching the theater,{SAUT}then found this customer―Hikari-san.
Due to my responsibility as curator,{SAUT}I've taken her under my care.
U-Uhhh... Um... I―U-Um...
Calm down, Futaba―it's okay!
Ah, u-um...
Y-Y-Yeah―Wait, huh?{PAGE}You're, uh, you're shaking a lot...
Yes―it's likely from the shock.{SAUT}She's awfully frightened.{PAGE}I've remained by her side in hopes of{SAUT}staving off some of her anxiety...
Oh that's right―Hey, did you happen to{SAUT}see Haru and Makoto anywhere!?{PAGE}They're our friends, but we got{SAUT}separated on the way here, so{SAUT}we're looking for them now!
...Your friends?
Mmhm, have you seen them? We've{SAUT}looked everywhere, but we can't find{SAUT}them!
What do your friends look like? Could{SAUT}you provide us with descriptions, or{SAUT}perhaps even photos?
Uhhh―well, one's all... spiky, and the{SAUT}other one's... got an axe?
Oh, I know! Yusuke, could you sketch{SAUT}them real quick?
I could if I had some supplies.
Very well. I'll fetch you some suitable{SAUT}materials.
They look like this.
Wow! That's so them!
Oh, these two―if I recall correctly,{SAUT}they were in the movie...{PAGE}Isn't that right, Hikari-san?
You know them!?
Oh―um...
...Nagi-san? Uh...
Hikari is whispering to Nagi...
What's with the whispering?
She could just tell us herself―right,{SAUT}{f 6 1 30 0 0 0}?
She's scared of you, Ryuji.{OPTION}She's just being careful.{OPTION}Let's wait and see what happens.
Mm, that could definitely be why{SAUT}she's so cautious.
Wha―!? Some weird talkin' cat's way{SAUT}scarier than me!
Don't call me weird!
It can't be helped. After all, we've got{SAUT}someone with us who looks like{SAUT}a common thug.
Who're you callin' a thug!? A talkin'{SAUT}cat's way weirder than me!
Don't call me weird!
Agreed.{PAGE}We have a blond thug and a talking{SAUT}monster cat with us... Her defensiveness{SAUT}is natural.
I ain't no thug!
Don't call me a monster cat!
Oh, looks like they're ready to share...
Just as I'd thought―both Hikari-san{SAUT}and I have seen your friends.{PAGE}We saw them in the movie, just like{SAUT}the rest of you.
Huh? Whaddaya mean, "in the movie"?
Those two were originally with your{SAUT}group, correct?
Uh, well―yeah, they were, but...
The "in the movie" part is what makes{SAUT}no sense.
We'll leave all that for later. So, what{SAUT}exactly happened with those two?
They've been captured by a character{SAUT}named "Kamoshidaman."
Uh, Kamoshidaman?
Wait, Kamoshida―!? What's going on{SAUT}here?
Hm? That sound...
It's starting again...
Wh-What's that supposed to mean!?
I believe Doe has begun playing{SAUT}the movie.
Doe? Movie?
...You'll understand better if you see it{SAUT}for yourselves.
